notes.title: Changes and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Changes:

Added fishing rod (Given by fisherman).
Increased max inventory by 5.
Added stamina regen of 1 every 6 seconds to reduce bed runs.
Made it more clear where to use keys.
Updated icons in research menu.
Added animation when walking for held tools.
Added action button label to text on hover.
Decreased volume on all volume types.


Bugfixes:

Fixed museum name being reset when travelling.
Fixed typo in message from ghost lady.
